title: PlayListing
description:
A Google Play store listing crawled live for one country and language.

Unlike `PlayApp`, nothing here comes from AppstoreSpy storage: the fields are
exactly what Google Play served for the requested `country` and `language` at
`crawled`, so any locale Google Play Console accepts can be requested.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country the listing was requested for (Google Play `gl`)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language the listing was requested in (Google Play `hl`)

crawled.title: Crawled
crawled.description: When Google Play was crawled, UTC

url.title: Url
url.description: Link to the listing on Google Play for this country and language

name.title: Name
name.description: Title as shown on Google Play

short.title: Short
short.description: Short description as shown on Google Play

description.title: Description
description.description: Full description as shown on Google Play

whatsnew.title: Whatsnew
whatsnew.description: What's new as shown on Google Play

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: Screenshot URLs in the order Google Play shows them

translated.title: Translated
translated.description: True when the developer has not supplied this language and Google Play shows a machine translation of the default listing; `short` and `description` are then that translation. False means the texts are the developer's own: a listing in this language, or the default listing when Google Play does not translate it.

translated_from.title: Translated From
translated_from.description: Source language of the machine translation, as Google Play names it in the requested language
